verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cron-based scheduled functions with timezone support (inngest-docs-17) and run-level observability/metrics/traces (inngest-docs-20), and concurrency/rate-limiting primitives exist (inngest-docs-12, inngest-docs-13) that could be used to prevent overlap. However, there is no explicit documentation of an overlap policy specifically for cron triggers, no evidence of pause/resume controls for scheduled functions, and no evidence of a dashboard view for upcoming/future cron runs. Missing for 10: explicit cron overlap-prevention policy docs, pause/resume of scheduled workflows, and a documented 'upcoming runs' scheduling view.
